programme.desc: Shruti and Bittoo launch Shaadi Mubarak, a wedding planning business. Their teamwork is strong, but Shruti falls for Bittoo, putting their professional partnership at risk. Release Year: 2010 Director: Maneesh Sharma Awards: 2011 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Debut Actor-Ranveer Singh, 2011 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Debut Director- Maneesh Sharma, Awards of the International Indian Film Academy IIFA- 2011 Winner Popular.

programme.title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
programme.desc: Raj, a rich, carefree, happy-go-lucky second generation NRI, follows Simran to India to win over her strict father and marry her. Release Year: 1995 Director: Aditya Chopra Awards: 43rd National Film Awards - Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment, 41st Filmfare Awards - Best Film.

programme.title: Housefull 4
programme.desc: In a twist of fate, three pairs of reincarnated lovers meet again today, but hilariously, the guys end up falling for the wrong gals. Love's complicated, right? Release Year: 2019 Director: Farhad Samji Awards: 2020 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award - The 200 Crore Club.

programme.title: Race 2
programme.desc: Ranvir treads through the world of the Indian mafia in Turkey as he looks to avenge the death of his lover and partner-in-crime. Release Year: 2013 Director: Abbas Alibhai Burmawalla, Mustan Alibhai Burmawalla, Awards: 2014 Winner Special Award- Power Club - Box Office Award, 2014 Winner Apsara Award- Hall of Fame.

programme.title: The Masterpiece
programme.desc: Defying his mother, Yuva dives into the underworld to become a local thug, but things get dangerous when a sudden clash with a drug lord ruins everything.

programme.title: Hiss.
programme.desc: Desperate to cure his brain cancer, George captures a cobra, triggering a deadly quest for revenge from its vengeful female counterpart. Immortality comes at a price.

programme.title: Ahista Ahista
programme.desc: Ankush, a wedding witness, helps Megha waiting for groom Dheeraj. They share a night, he falls in love, contemplates change, encounters Dheeraj, and acts boldly. Release Year: 2006 Director: Shivam Nair Awards: 2007 Winner Popular Award- Sabsey Favourite Nayi Heroine- Soha Ali Khan.

programme.title: 777 Charlie
programme.desc: A father's choices and unexpected turns of fate put his family's safety at risk, leading to emotional conflict and a desperate fight for survival.

programme.title: Baabul
programme.desc: After his son's death, Balraj tries to get Millie, his daughter-in-law, to marry Rajat, her childhood friend. However, Millie's reluctance and opposition from his family members obstruct his plan. Release Year: 2006 Director: Ravi Chopra.

programme.title: Son Of Sardaar
programme.desc: Returning to his parents' village, a man becomes the latest target in a long-standing family feud. Release Year: 2012 Director: Ashwani Dhir Awards: Power Club - Box Office Award: Ashwani Dhir Zee Cine Awards.

programme.title: Hulchul
programme.desc: Anjali and Jai from rival families, pretend to be in love with each other to avenge their insults. Chaos follows when they really fall in love. Release Year: 2004 Director: Priyadarshan.

programme.title: Chak De India
programme.desc: Kabir Khan, once a top hockey player, faces disgrace after a tournament loss. To prove his loyalty, he coaches the **Indian women's hockey team**, guiding them to victory and redemption.

programme.title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited
programme.desc: Four guys bound together by their child-like notoriety, aimlessness and petty business of conning people for fun and money. Release Year: 2006 Director: Rohit Shetty.

programme.title: Aavesham
programme.desc: Three engineering students arrive in Bangalore for their studies but soon get caught in a conflict. Struggling to handle the situation, they turn to a local gangster for help, risking everything.

programme.title: Krishna Cottage
programme.desc: A bunch of youngsters are in a car. On their way, strange things start happening and they are forced to seek shelter in Krishna Cottage. Watch the thriller starring Sohail Khan and Isha Koppikar. Release Year: 2004 Director: Santram Varma.

programme.title: Tumse Na Ho Payega
programme.desc: In a hilarious turn of events, Gaurav and his friends rediscover themselves when they decide to follow their hearts and defy the expectations of society. Release Year: 2023 Director: Abhishek Sinha.

programme.title: The Great Samshuddin Family
programme.desc: An eccentric family navigates hilarious daily mishaps, domestic squabbles, and heartwarming moments, constantly finding funny ways to stay united despite their endless personal differences. Release Year: 2025 Director: Anusha Rizvi.

programme.title: Lamhe
programme.desc: Viren falls for Pallavi, but she marries Siddharth. The couple dies, leaving behind their daughter, who grows up to look just like her mother and falls in love with Viren. Release Year: 1991 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best Film - Yash Chopra, Best Story - Honey Irani, Best Dialogue - Rahi Masoom Raza, Best Costume Design - Neeta Lulla.

programme.title: Tikdam
programme.desc: A devoted father faces tough choices when a job offer in Mumbai threatens to separate him from his family. His children unite to save their town, sparking hope. Release Year: 2024 Director: Vivek Anchalia Awards: Special Recognition Award at the Indian Film Festival of Houston IFFH, Special Mention Award at the Jagran Film Festival, Best Script and Best Child Actor at the e4m Play Streaming Media Awards.

programme.title: Aaja Nachle
programme.desc: Dia returns home to find her beloved dance theatre facing demolition. Determined to save it, she inspires the indifferent townspeople to join a dance performance and fight for its survival. Release Year: 2007 Director: Anil Mehta Awards: IIFA Award: Best Choreography: Vaibhavi Merchant.

programme.title: Abcd 2

programme.desc: Anjali is very friendly with Rahul. Rahul falls in love with Tina and marries her. This breaks Anjali's heart and she decides to settle far away. Release Year: 1998 Director: Karan Johar Awards: 5 Filmfare Awards, National Film Awards, Screen Awards, 4 IIFA Awards.

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last of the Giants
programme.sub-title: Beginning in the Americas, Patrick finds out more about the planet's largest predator, the sperm whale, comes face to face with grizzlies, and gets up close with the anaconda as he reveals how these giants shape their environments
programme.desc: Shot across the continents of Australia, Asia, the Americas and Africa, this three-part nature documentary series delves into the Earth's biggest beasts, from five-ton elephant seals to the dignified African lion. Biologist Patrick Aryee embarks on a global mission to explore the biggest beasts and the conservation challenges that face them in an ever-changing world. Full of beautiful natural history photography, illustrated graphics of extinct gigantic beasts and stunning close encounters, this series looks at why size really does matter in the natural world.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: An unforgettable expedition across diverse landscapes of Africa exploring the fascinating lives of their extraordinary inhabitants.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: We travel from the forests of Hokkaido to the shores of Okinawa to uncover the secrets of Japan's most extraordinary creatures.

programme.title: Hot Life Africa
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.sub-title: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a duelling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: Hippos After Dark
programme.desc: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.sub-title: The Texas team of gator savers take a paddle boat out for a rescue mission where the hunt for a sneaky gator ends in chest-deep water, and a gator with an eye problem gets a checkup
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home \"Gator Country.\".

programme.title: Just Animals
programme.desc: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

programme.title: Jewels of the Natural World
programme.desc: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce.

programme.title: Into the Wild: India
programme.desc: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive.

programme.title: Viper Queens
programme.desc: Velvet the Gaboon viper and Therma the rattlesnake are two mothers facing different challenges in extreme, contrasting landscapes.

programme.title: Wolves \u0026 Lions: Old Enemies
programme.sub-title: Canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines face endurance, while wolves rely on their privileged sense of smell in a constant fight for survival
programme.desc: Across the planet, wolves and lions lead two legendary predator lineages: canids and felines. We explore their differences and similarities, from brute strength to social intelligence, revealing who dominates in each territory.

programme.title: The Savannah: Wild Happiness
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.title: Gladiators
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: Exploring life-defining battles amongst the animal kingdom's greatest rivals. Like gladiatorial battles, the animal showdowns are set in different wild 'arenas', including the Pacific Northwest, African savannah, jungle coasts, and Australia.

programme.title: Wild Wild Bunch
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: Examine the razor-sharp claws, teeth, and senses of these wild killing machines.

programme.title: Animal Armory
programme.sub-title: Bears, owls, and tigers use their sharp claws to fight and catch prey, while baboons, wolves and woodchucks use their teeth as weapons
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: Wolves \u0026 Lions: Old Enemies

programme.desc: Across the planet, wolves and lions lead two legendary predator lineages: canids and felines. We explore their differences and similarities, from brute strength to social intelligence, revealing who dominates in each territory.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

credits.actor: Fernando Monezzi,Arjuna Sundara,Sara Parra,Sócrates Demitres,Marcelly Mota,Rajnee Om,Bruno Fonseca,Fabiola Zuckert,Carlos Albertini,Aline Lopes,Dinho

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: A former male cheerleader and a cowgirl take on the South African bush. But potential tick bites and scorpion stings put their challenge at risk
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.sub-title: Prabhat loses his voice in an accident while trying to save his stepmother. However, his sacrifice goes unappreciated by a family largely filled with selfish and unethical people
programme.desc: प्रभात अपनी सौतेली माँ को बचाने की कोशिश करते हुए एक दुर्घटना में अपनी आवाज खो देता है। हालांकि, उसका स्वार्थी और अनैतिक परिवार उसकी हर कुर्बानी का अनादर करता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty (Prabhat),Mamta Kulkarni (Naina),Prem Chopra (Prem Chopra),Mohnish Behl (Surya),Daisy Irani (Chanda),Aruna Irani (Ganga),Tiku Talsania (Naina's dad),Sunila Karambelkar (Anu Chopra)

programme.title: पाप की दुनिया
programme.sub-title: Suraj, a criminal, and Vijay, a policeman, vie for each other's blood, unaware that they are brothers. Things turn more complicated when they both fall in love with the same woman
programme.desc: सूरज खुद को आरती के प्यार के लिए बदलता है,लेकिन उसे पता चलता है कि उसे धोखा दिया गया है। आरती का पूर्व-प्रेमी,पुलिसकर्मी,हर कीमत पर सूरज को गिरफ्तार करना चाहता है और एक गैंगस्टर भी उसे मारना चाहता है।.

credits.actor: Sunny Deol (Suraj/Ashok),Neelam Kothari (Aarti),Pran (Jailer),Danny Denzongpa (Pasha),Chunky Pandey (Inspector Vijay),Shakti Kapoor (Kisna),Mac Mohan

programme.title: आग
programme.sub-title: A young man seeks a fresh start in a village after enduring tragedy, only to find himself entangled in a conflict that tests his strength and sense of justice
programme.desc: एक भाई और बहन, समाज में बेईमानी और भ्रष्टाचार के खिलाफ लड़ते हैं। खोया प्यार और भ्रष्ट पुलिस अधिकारी उनकी परेशानी बढ़ाते हैं, जिसके कारण वे नई पहचान अपनाने और नए सिरे से शुरुआत करने को मजबूर होते हैं।.

credits.actor: Govinda (Raju/Birju),Shilpa Shetty Kundra (Bijli / Inspector Barkha Sharma),Sonali Bendre (Parul),Shakti Kapoor (Inspector Suryadev Singh),Mohnish Behl (Bobby),Gulshan Grover (Chhote thakur Madhav Singh),Kader Khan (Tolaram),Sadashiv Amrapurkar (Bholaram),Goga Kapoor (Thakur Madan Singh),Avtar Gill (Jagpal)

programme.title: दिल है बेताब
programme.sub-title: Meena and Raja, who are in love with each other, decide to marry. However, when her father's employer asks for Meena's hand in marriage, he accepts his proposal and ruins his daughter's life
programme.desc: मीना और राजा एक दूसरे से प्यार करते है और शादी करनेका फैसला करते है।हालांकि,जब उसके पिता का मालिक शादी के लिए मीना का हाथ मांगता है तब वह प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करता है।क्या मीना इस रिश्ते को स्वीकार करेगी?

credits.actor: Vivek Mushran,Ajay Devgan,Pratibha Sinha,Mohnish Behl,Kader Khan,Anjana Mumtaz,Alok Nath,Rakesh Bedi

programme.title: हम आपके दिल में रहते हैं
programme.sub-title: Love begins with a marriage of convenience and stays with Megha and Vijay in the throes of separation. In a classic case of unfortunate timing, one realises it too soon, while the other is too late
programme.desc: विजय एक शर्त पर शादी करने के लिए राजी है कि उसकी पत्नी को एक साल का अनुबंध करना होगा कि यदि वह अपने प्रति विजय के मन में प्यार न जगा पाई तो शादी खत्म हो जाएगी। मेघा इस शर्त को स्वीकार करती है।.

credits.actor: Anil Kapoor,Kajol,Anupam Kher,Johnny Lever,Satish Kaushik,Shakti Kapoor,Gracy Singh,Sudha Chandran,Rakesh Bedi,Parmeet Sethi,Dinesh Hingoo,Mink Singh

programme.title: तारे जमीन पर
programme.sub-title: Ishaan is criticised by his parents for his poor academic performance and is sent away to a boarding school. Ram, an art teacher, however, realises he has dyslexia and helps him uncover his potential
programme.desc: ईशान के माता-पिता, खराब शैक्षणिक प्रदर्शन के लिए उसकी आलोचना कर, उसे बोर्डिंग स्कूल भेज देते हैं। हालाँकि, कला शिक्षक राम को उसके डिस्लेक्सिया की बीमारी का पता चलता है।.

credits.actor: Darsheel Safary (Ishaan Awasthi),Aamir Khan (Ram Shankar Nikumbh),Tanay Chheda (Rajan Damodran),Sachet Engineer (Yohaan Nandkishore Awasthi),Tisca Chopra (Maya Awasthi),Vipin Sharma (Nandkishore Awasthi)

programme.title: मुंबई सागा
programme.sub-title: After Amartya Rao's brother is brutally attacked by goons, he enters the world of crime and becomes a powerful gangster. However, he must engage with other crime bosses and a vengeful policeman
programme.desc: भाई को गुंडों द्वारा लगभग मार देने पर अमर्त्य राव अंडरवर्ल्ड में प्रवेश करता है।.

programme.title: बिग न्यूज बिग एनालिसिस

programme.title: ஷான் த ஷீப்
programme.sub-title: Shaun, a remarkably intelligent sheep and leader of his flock at Mossy Bottom Farm, endeavours to inject some thrill into their monotonous routine while avoiding detection by the farmer
programme.desc: ஒரு சிறிய பண்ணையில் மந்தையை வழிநடத்தும் புத்திசாலி ஆடு தன் நண்பர்களுடன் சாகசத்தில் ஈடுபட்டு செம்மறி நாயுடன் மோதுகிறது.

credits.actor: John Sparkes (Bitzer),Justin Fletcher (Shaun),Kate Harbour (Timmy's Mother),Richard Webber (Shirley),Jo Allen (Timmy's Mother)

programme.title: ஷான் த ஷீப்
programme.sub-title: Shaun, a remarkably intelligent sheep and leader of his flock at Mossy Bottom Farm, endeavours to inject some thrill into their monotonous routine while avoiding detection by the farmer
programme.desc: ஒரு சிறிய பண்ணையில் மந்தையை வழிநடத்தும் புத்திசாலி ஆடு தன் நண்பர்களுடன் சாகசத்தில் ஈடுபட்டு செம்மறி நாயுடன் மோதுகிறது.

credits.actor: John Sparkes (Bitzer),Justin Fletcher (Shaun),Kate Harbour (Timmy's Mother),Richard Webber (Shirley),Jo Allen (Timmy's Mother)

programme.sub-title: Shaun, a remarkably intelligent sheep and leader of his flock at Mossy Bottom Farm, endeavours to inject some thrill into their monotonous routine while avoiding detection by the farmer
programme.desc: ஒரு சிறிய பண்ணையில் மந்தையை வழிநடத்தும் புத்திசாலி ஆடு தன் நண்பர்களுடன் சாகசத்தில் ஈடுபட்டு செம்மறி நாயுடன் மோதுகிறது.

credits.actor: John Sparkes (Bitzer),Justin Fletcher (Shaun),Kate Harbour (Timmy's Mother),Richard Webber (Shirley),Jo Allen (Timmy's Mother)

programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: సూపర్ సింగూ

programme.title: మహా గణేశా
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు సరి కొత్త
programme.sub-title: Moral-filled tales come to life as engaging characters navigate challenges, teaching lessons on wisdom, honesty and friendship through captivating storytelling
programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.title: छोटा भीम

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: सम्पत और चम्पत, दो चोर, लगातार ऐसी गड़बड़ योजनाएँ बनाते रहते हैं जो उन्हीं पर भारी पड़ जाती हैं, और जिसके चलते वे स्थानीय पुलिस के साथ कभी न खत्म होने वाली मुसीबतों में फँस जाते हैं।.

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: जय जगन्नाथ
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता ओडिशा के पुरी में भगवान जगन्नाथ की स्तुति में आयोजित वार्षिक रथ यात्रा पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जिसमें देश भर से बड़ी संख्या में भक्त शामिल होते हैं।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: सम्पत चम्पत
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: सम्पत और चम्पत, दो चोर, लगातार ऐसी गड़बड़ योजनाएँ बनाते रहते हैं जो उन्हीं पर भारी पड़ जाती हैं, और जिसके चलते वे स्थानीय पुलिस के साथ कभी न खत्म होने वाली मुसीबतों में फँस जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम क्लाउन टाउन में शोडाउन
programme.sub-title: A brave young police officer ventures into Clown Town, facing mischievous villains and overcoming challenges, proving his courage and determination to restore order and justice
programme.desc: एक बहादुर पुलिस ऑफिसर, क्लाउन टाउन में जाता है और शरारती विलेन का सामना करते हुए चुनौतियों को पार करता है। वह व्यवस्था और न्याय वापस लाने के लिए अपनी हिम्मत और पक्के इरादे को साबित करता है।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम और कृष्णा: कंस का आतंक पार्ट- 1 - दोस्ती की डोर एण्ड कर्मा कलश की खोज
programme.sub-title: Kans teams up with Shambhala Jambala to resurrect himself by using a life-giving tree. Soon, Little Singham and Krishna set out to stop them before their evil plan destroys Earth
programme.desc: कंस, शम्भाला जम्बाला के साथ मिलकर जीवन प्रदान करने वाले पेड़ का उपयोग करके खुद को पुनर्जीवित करता है। इससे पहले कि कंस की योजना पृथ्वी को नष्ट करे, लिटिल सिंघम और कृष्णा उस रोकने निकल पड़ते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम और कृष्णा: कंस का आतंक पार्ट - 2 - ऋतु पत्थर एण्ड संतुलन की नाव
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and Krishna go to Prakatalay in a bid to find the 'Ritu Pathar'. But Kans and his demons are hell-bent on stopping them from completing their mission
programme.desc: लिटिल सिंघम और कृष्ण, 'ऋतु ​​पत्थर' खोजने के लिए प्राकटालय जाते हैं। लेकिन कंस और उसके राक्षस उन्हें उनका मिशन पूरा करने से रोकते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम और कृष्णा: कंस का आतंक पार्ट - 3 - सूर्य नगरी एण्ड लौट आया कंस
programme.sub-title: Amidst their battle against Kans, Little Singham and Krishna travel to Surya Nagri. There, they are attacked by the evil Shambhala Jambala who is close to resurrecting Kans
programme.desc: कंस के खिलाफ अपनी लड़ाई में लिटिल सिंघम और कृष्णा सूर्य नगरी की यात्रा करते हैं। वहां, उन पर दुष्ट शम्भाला जम्बाला द्वारा हमला किया जाता है जो कंस को फिर से जीवित करने के करीब है।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: बिग बीस्ट्स: लास्ट ऑफ द जाएंट्स
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee presents a breathtaking look at Earth's biggest animals, exploring their habitats, evolution and the conservation efforts to protect them across continents
programme.desc: पैट्रिक एरी पृथ्वी के सबसे विशाल जानवरों की एक लुभावनी झलक पेश करते हैं, जिसमें वे उनके आवासों, विकास और उन्हें बचाने के लिए विभिन्न महाद्वीपों में किए जा रहे संरक्षण प्रयासों की पड़ताल करते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड किंग्ड्म्स
programme.sub-title: While rivers are the womb of a place, it is ruled by dangerous creatures like hippos, crocodiles, water monitors and fish eagles who battle relentlessly to establish supremacy
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता दुनिया भर में यात्रा कर विशाल परिदृश्यों में रहने वाले और प्रकृति की कठोरता को सहन करने वाले कुछ सबसे मजबूत जानवरों को कैमरे में कैद करते हैं।.

programme.title: जापान्स वाइल्ड साइड
programme.sub-title: A filmmaker travels from Hokkaido's forests to the coastlines of Okinawa to discover the secrets of Japan's most iconic animals
programme.desc: एक फ़िल्मकार जापान के सबसे मशहूर जानवरों के राज़ जानने के लिए होक्काइडो के जंगलों से ओकिनावा के तटों तक का सफ़र करते हैं।.

programme.title: द विदा एन एल अफ्रीका आर्डियंटे
programme.sub-title: Take look at some of the tricks employed by cheetahs in order to protect themselves from the scorching sun in the wilderness
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता दुनिया के सबसे गर्म क्षेत्रों में जलवायु परिवर्तन के खतरे पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और बताते हैं कि कैसे जानवरों ने बदलते पर्यावरण के साथ खुद को समायोजित किया है।.

programme.title: बैटल ऑफ दी अल्फ़ाज़
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पशु साम्राज्य की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के बीच संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करते हैं और प्रतिद्वंद्विता के पीछे के उद्देश्यों को समझने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: बैटल ऑफ दी अल्फ़ाज़
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker documents the conflict between various species of the animal kingdom and understands the motives behind the rivalry
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पशु साम्राज्य की विभिन्न प्रजातियों के बीच संघर्ष का दस्तावेजीकरण करते हैं और प्रतिद्वंद्विता के पीछे के उद्देश्यों को समझने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता रात के समय एक खूंखार बैल के संरक्षण में शेरों के एक समूह और दरियाई घोड़ों के एक झुंड के बीच चरम शक्ति-खेल और अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष को फिल्म में दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: टेक्सास गेटर सेवर्स
programme.sub-title: The team boards a paddle boat to reach a survivor during a low-tech rescue mission. Meanwhile, the crew is lured into deep water by an elusive alligator as a wounded beast receives medical care
programme.desc: गेरी सॉरेज और उनकी टीम विभिन्न अजीबोगरीब स्थानों से मगरमच्छों को रेस्क्यू करती है और नए वातावरण में उनकी भलाई सुनिश्चित करती है।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड बैटलग्राउंड
programme.sub-title: Animals face intense challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.title: वूल्व्स एंड लायंस: ओल्ड एनिमीज़
programme.sub-title: Discover the power and hierarchies of African lions and wolves, exploring how they use social strategies to raise their young
programme.desc: कुत्ते और बिल्ली प्रजाति के जानवर दुनिया भर में सबसे बड़े शिकारी के तौर पर एक-दूसरे को टक्कर देते हैं। उनकी ताकत और चालाकी की तुलना से पता चलता है कि किस परिवार का किसी इलाके पर दबदबा है।.

programme.title: एक्सट्रीम बग्स
programme.desc: Extreme Bugs.

programme.title: रेनफॉरेस्ट रीवाइल्ड
programme.desc: Rainforest Rewild.

programme.title: द ग्रेट एलिफ़ेंट टेल
programme.sub-title: A calf navigates the Okavango Delta, a bull searches for a mate, and a matriarch leads her family through the desert. These adventures combine to tell the story of Africa's most iconic species
programme.desc: अफ्रीका की प्रतिष्ठित प्रजातियों की कहानियां, जिसमें ओकावांगो डेल्टा में घूमते बछड़े, अपने साथी की तलाश करते बैल, और रेगिस्तान में अपने परिवार के साथ घूमती महिला को दिखाते हैं।.

programme.title: नैचरल बॉर्न मॉन्सटर्स
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: द लेपर्ड रॉक्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on the life of Neelam, a female leopard, as she strives to protect the lives of her cubs in the wild
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार मादा तेंदुआ नीलम के जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जो जंगल में अपने शावकों के जीवन की रक्षा करने का प्रयास करती है।.

programme.title: श्रीलंका - लेपर्ड्स ऑफ याला
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides an intimate look at Yala's leopards, showcasing their behaviours and survival instincts in a park with one of the world's highest concentrations of these magnificent predators
programme.desc: फिल्मकार, याला के तेंदुओं की जानकारी देते हैं, तथा इन शानदार शिकारियों की विश्व में सर्वाधिक संख्या वाले पार्क में उनके व्यवहार और जीवित रहने की प्रवृत्ति दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: बिग कैट्स: एन अमेजिंग एनिमल फ़ैमिली
programme.sub-title: Zoologist Patrick Aryee comes within a whisker of some of Earth's most majestic predators as he embarks on a remarkable journey through the feline family tree
programme.desc: शिकारी बिल्लियों की 37 अलग-अलग प्रजातियाँ हर जंगली इलाके पर राज करती हैं। एक जीवविज्ञानी उनकी सफलता और उनके विविध वंशवृक्ष का पता लगाते हैं।.

programme.title: ऑन द ट्रेल ऑफ स्नो लेपर्ड
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता हिम तेंदुओं की खोज में निकल पड़ते हैं और विशेषज्ञों के अनुभवों को रिकॉर्ड करते हैं जो इन जानवरों के चट्टानी परिदृश्यों में घूमते हुए दुर्लभ दृश्य देखते हैं।.

programme.title: सर्व्हायविंग अर्थ
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: वाइल्ड बैटलग्राउंड
programme.sub-title: Animals face intense challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: The filmmaker provides insights into some of the unique characteristics of various predatory animals while focusing on their survival instincts.

programme.title: द सवाना: वाइल्ड हैप्पिनेस
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.sub-title: Battles of the wild include territorial brawl between lions and elephants, ants raiding on a termite mould and a honey badger's face-off with a snake
programme.desc: चार अनोखे पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों में जीवन जीने के संघर्षों पर जानकारी, जानवरों के साम्राज्य में भयंकर प्रतिद्वंद्विता, छोटी चींटियों से लेकर विशाल भालुओं का जीवन संघर्ष।.

programme.title: एनिमल आरमोरी
programme.sub-title: Learn about lethal claws which can be used to catch prey, and teeth that can be used both as defensive and offensive weapons
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता, जंगली जानवर के हमला करने, बचाव करने और शिकार करने के लिए प्राकृतिक हथियारों से लैस होने के बारे में बताते हैं जिससे उनका अस्तित्व सुनिश्चित होता है।.

programme.title: वूल्व्स एंड लायंस: ओल्ड एनिमीज़

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker examines the spectrum of animal speeds and delves into the ecological factors that shape these contrasting behaviours
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पशुओं की गति के तरंगों की जांच करते हैं तथा उन पारिस्थितिक कारकों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जो इन विपरीत व्यवहारों को आकार देते हैं।.

programme.title: बर्थ ऑफ स्पीड
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of two mother cheetahs, who strive to nurture and train their cubs to survive in the wild
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार दो मादा चीतों की यात्रा का पता लगाते हैं, जो जंगल में जीवित रहने के लिए अपने बच्चों का पालन-पोषण और प्रशिक्षण करने का प्रयास करती हैं।.

programme.title: नेचर्स फास्ट अटैक्स
programme.sub-title: In the age-old battle between predator and prey, subterfuge and speed can be a case of life or death for many animals from tigers to cuttlefish
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता प्रकृति के बड़े शिकारियों को फिल्माने के लिए दुनिया की यात्रा करते हैं क्योंकि वे अपने शिकार का पीछा करने और हमला करने के लिए अपनी गति और चपलता का उपयोग करते हैं।.

programme.title: द व्यू फ़्रोम द हाइ
programme.sub-title: Using drones, helicopters and balloons, the filmmaker attempts to uncover the hidden secrets of nature that have been inaccessible to humans
programme.desc: ड्रोन, हेलीकॉप्टर और गुब्बारों का उपयोग करते हुए, फिल्म निर्माता प्रकृति के उन छिपे रहस्यों को उजागर करने का प्रयास करता है जो मनुष्यों के लिए दुर्गम हैं।.

programme.title: श्रीलंका - लेपर्ड्स ऑफ याला
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides an intimate look at Yala's leopards, showcasing their behaviours and survival instincts in a park with one of the world's highest concentrations of these magnificent predators
programme.desc: फिल्मकार, याला के तेंदुओं की जानकारी देते हैं, तथा इन शानदार शिकारियों की विश्व में सर्वाधिक संख्या वाले पार्क में उनके व्यवहार और जीवित रहने की प्रवृत्ति दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: ग्लेडियेटर्स
programme.sub-title: Battles of the wild include territorial brawl between lions and elephants, ants raiding on a termite mould and a honey badger's face-off with a snake
programme.desc: चार अनोखे पारिस्थितिक तंत्रों में जीवन जीने के संघर्षों पर जानकारी, जानवरों के साम्राज्य में भयंकर प्रतिद्वंद्विता, छोटी चींटियों से लेकर विशाल भालुओं का जीवन संघर्ष।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड वाइल्ड बंच
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers detailed insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार विविध वन्यजीवों के व्यवहारिक और शारीरिक पहलुओं के साथ-साथ जीवित रहने और अपने शिकार को हराने के लिए उनके द्वारा अपनाई जाने वाली रणनीतियों पर भी प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: एनिमल अटैक रेट
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the calculative attacking instincts of nature's some of the deadliest predators in Australia and their execution of the plan whilst combating the risk
programme.desc: फिल्मकार, जंगल के शातिर शिकारियों द्वारा प्रदर्शित आक्रमण प्रवृत्ति पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा उनके घातक व्यवहार के बारे में जानकारी देते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड कैट्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the predatory moves of the ferocious wild cats of Africa and delves into their daily routine, capturing vivid moments
programme.desc: जंगली बिल्लियों की कई शानदार लेकिन क्रूर प्रजातियाँ कुछ सबसे चुनौतीपूर्ण क्षेत्रों में अस्तित्व के लिए लड़ने के लिए अपने अविश्वसनीय कौशल का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: वूल्व्स एंड लायंस: ओल्ड एनिमीज़

programme.title: डॉग्स इन द लैंड ऑफ लायंस
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows the extraordinary journey of closely-bonded wild dogs in Zimbabwe, capturing their tender moments to wild hunting
programme.desc: फिल्मकार, जिम्बाब्वे में घनिष्ठ रूप से एक-दूसरे से जुड़े जंगली कुत्तों की अद्भुत यात्रा का वर्णन करते हैं, तथा शिकार के दौरान उनके कोमल क्षणों को कैमरा में कैद करते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers detailed insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife

programme.title: लेपर्ड डायनेस्टी: द राइज ऑफ राणा
programme.desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a power struggle; aging leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance; as father and son clash, alliances form, instincts sharpen.

programme.title: वाइल्ड एण्ड वंडरफुल डेनमार्क
programme.sub-title: Take a look at a yellow-necked mouse that is pursued by an eagle-owl, a mother fox and her newborn cub and a soar with a golden eagle while it is out hunting
programme.desc: डेनमार्क के वन्यजीवों पर जानकारी के लिए पशु जगत में होने वाली नाटकीय घटनाओं का अनुसरण किया जाता है। जन्म और मृत्यु, मिलन और भूख, शिकार या शिकार होने की कहानियाँ सुनाई जाती हैं।.

programme.title: माइंड वाइल्ड
programme.sub-title: Explore the elements of intelligence as various animals develop wondrous strategies to create nests, safe houses, caves and other constructions
programme.desc: वन्यजीव विशेषज्ञ अपने प्राकृतिक आवासों में जीवित रहने वाले जंगली जानवरों के व्यवहार का अध्ययन कर, उनकी बुद्धिमत्ता की जटिलता के बारे में विस्तृत जानकारी देते हैं।.

programme.title: ऑन द ट्रेल ऑफ स्नो लेपर्ड
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता हिम तेंदुओं की खोज में निकल पड़ते हैं और विशेषज्ञों के अनुभवों को रिकॉर्ड करते हैं जो इन जानवरों के चट्टानी परिदृश्यों में घूमते हुए दुर्लभ दृश्य देखते हैं।.

programme.title: बैस्चन ऑफ द जायन्ट्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of Asian elephants in the jungles of Northeast India, highlighting conservation efforts to ensure a harmonious future for both humans and wildlife
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार पूर्वोत्तर भारत के जंगलों में एशियाई हाथियों के जीवन का अन्वेषण करते हैं, तथा मानव और वन्यजीव दोनों के लिए सामंजस्यपूर्ण भविष्य सुनिश्चित करने के लिए संरक्षण प्रयासों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: नैचरल बॉर्न मॉन्सटर्स
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: सिबेला - द मिरेकल चीता

programme.title: वाइल्ड फ्रैंक मेक्सिको
programme.sub-title: Frank Cuesta travels across the Caribbean Sea and ventures into the forests of Mexico to explore the flora and fauna while unearthing the truth about ancient Mayan myths
programme.desc: फ्रैंक क्यूस्टा कैरेबियन सागर में यात्रा करते हैं और मैक्सिको के जंगलों में जाकर वनस्पतियों और जीवों का पता लगाते हैं और प्राचीन माया मिथकों के बारे में सच्चाई का पता लगाते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड लैटम
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker visits various locations in South America in an attempt to explore the beauty of nature and the lives of various wild animals
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता प्रकृति की सुंदरता और विभिन्न जंगली जानवरों के जीवन का पता लगाने के प्रयास में दक्षिण अमेरिका में विभिन्न स्थानों का दौरा करते हैं।.

programme.title: मैन वर्सेस बियर
programme.sub-title: Contestants compete against three grizzly bears, Bart, Honey Bump and Tank, in a series of tasks that tests their strength and endurance
programme.desc: प्रतियोगी कार्यों की एक श्रृंखला में तीन भूरे भालू, बार्ट, हनी बम्प और टैंक के खिलाफ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं जो उनकी ताकत और सहनशक्ति का परीक्षण करते हैं।.

programme.desc: Before complaining about the market price of Alaska king crab, check out this gripping documentary series, revealing the mortal perils and intense discomfort that fishing crews face to catch the delicacy; those perils include 40-foot waves, 700-pound crab pots that can easily crush a careless crewman, and freezing temperatures around the clock.

programme.title: My 600-Lb. Life
programme.sub-title: Geno and Nico strive to lose weight through diet and gastric bypass surgery with the help of Dr Younan Nowzaradan
programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid Brazil
programme.sub-title: The survivors become desperate from hunger. Meanwhile, differences in strategies push relationships to the limit, and a tropical storm tests the shelter
programme.desc: Men and women, who meet naked on camera, form pairs and are challenged to survive in one of the most inhospitable environments in the world without food, water or clothes.

credits.actor: Fernando Monezzi,Arjuna Sundara,Sara Parra,Sócrates Demitres,Marcelly Mota,Rajnee Om,Bruno Fonseca,Fabiola Zuckert,Carlos Albertini,Aline Lopes,Dinho

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: A former male cheerleader and a cowgirl take on the South African bush. But potential tick bites and scorpion stings put their challenge at risk
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.sub-title: Survivalist Lynsey finds herself at odds with her companion Darvil, whose lone-wolf tendencies become destructive in the gruelling terrain of Lapalala, South Africa
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: जुगलबंदी
programme.sub-title: Talented and renowned singers from the Indian classical music genre showcase their singing skills while performing a duet with live music
programme.desc: भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत शैली के प्रतिभाशाली और प्रसिद्ध गायक लाइव संगीत के साथ युगल प्रदर्शन करते हुए अपने गायन कौशल का प्रदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: सफ़र नामा

programme.title: पूज्य कौशिक जी महाराज
programme.sub-title: An eminent spiritual leader provides a comprehensive and detailed insight into important teachings and guides people on the right path

programme.title: सत्संग स्पेशल
programme.sub-title: A religious leader provides a detailed discourse on various spiritual teachings to devotees and encourages them to lead a faithful life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक भक्तों को विभिन्न आध्यात्मिक शिक्षाओं पर विस्तृत प्रवचन देते हुए उन्हें एक आस्थावान जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य मां कंकेश्वरी देवी जी
programme.desc: Religious leader Maa Kankeshwari Deviji delivers a discourse on spirituality and recites the Ram Katha to take devotees closer to God.

programme.title: आराधना
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs sung to express veneration for divine figures in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace and calm in devotees
programme.desc: भक्तों में शांति और स्थिरता की भावना पैदा करने के उद्देश्य से दिव्य व्यक्तियों के प्रति श्रद्धा व्यक्त करने के लिए गाए गए भक्ति गीतों के व्यापक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: सेल्फ रीअलिज़ेशन विथ साध्वी भगवती
programme.sub-title: The host engages in a discussion with a spiritual leader about life wisdom and pursuing the path of spirituality and devotion
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक के साथ जीवन ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिकता तथा भक्ति के मार्ग पर चलने के बारे में चर्चा करते हैं।.

programme.title: संकीर्तन
programme.sub-title: A famous religious leader sings hymns in praise of Lord Krishna in front of devotees in a bid to imbibe a sense of peace in them
programme.desc: एक प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्तों में शांति की भावना पैदा करने के लिए उनके सामने भगवान कृष्ण की स्तुति में भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य गुरु मी मां जी
programme.sub-title: Pujya Guru Mee Maa ji
programme.desc: विषय विशेषज्ञ वेल्डिंग जोड़ों और उनकी कमियों पर प्रासंगिक उदाहरणों सहित व्यापक और विस्तृत व्याख्यान प्रस्तुत करते हैं।.

programme.title: सत्संग-अमृत
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader explores the path to a pious life through the wisdom of Hinduism, sharing timeless precepts as well as teachings
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक हिंदू धर्म के ज्ञान के माध्यम से पवित्र जीवन के मार्ग की खोज कर, कालातीत उपदेशों के साथ-साथ शिक्षाओं को भी साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: आचार्य बालकृषण जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the benefits of 'Ayurveda' and shares various treatments to help patients suffering from various ailments
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, 'आयुर्वेद' के लाभों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं तथा विभिन्न बीमारियों से पीड़ित रोगियों की मदद के लिए विभिन्न उपचार बताते हैं।.

programme.title: मोरारी बापू
programme.sub-title: Morari Bapu reads out and explains significant excerpts from the Rama Katha while giving his interpretation of the same and highlighting its importance
programme.desc: मोरारी बापू रामकथा के महत्वपूर्ण अंश पढ़ते और समझाते हैं, साथ ही उसकी अपनी व्याख्या और उसके महत्व पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: जतिन अग्रवाल जी
programme.sub-title: Jatin Agrawal Ji sings a series of soulful and melodious devotional songs in praise of the Almighty to foster a deep spiritual connection for the listeners
programme.desc: जतिन अग्रवाल जी सर्वशक्तिमान की स्तुति में हृदयस्पर्शी और मधुर भक्ति गीतों की एक श्रृंखला प्रस्तुत करते हैं, ताकि श्रोताओं के भीतर आध्यात्मिक जुड़ाव स्थापित हो सके।.

programme.title: महावीर शर्मा जी
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs, hymns and sacred chants in praise of the Almighty is played back-to-back
programme.desc: ईश्वर की स्तुति में भक्ति गीतों, भजनों और पवित्र मंत्रों का व्यापक संकलन लगातार प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: कृषण भैया सिरसा वाले
programme.sub-title: Bhaiya Krishan Das, a spiritual adept, reads passages and sacred verses from a religious text, explains their meaning and further sings hymns with the devotees

programme.desc: தங்கள் கோட்டையை எரித்த எதிரிகளை, பழிவாங்க நினைக்கும் ஒரே உணர்வுடைய இரட்டை இளவரசர்கள் கரிகாலன் மற்றும் மணிவண்ணன்.

credits.actor: M. G. Ramachandran,J. Jayalalitha,S. A. Ashokan,R.S. Manohar,Cho Ramaswamy,Thengai Srinivasan,Manorama

programme.title: மியூசிக் எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs produced by renowned artists is played to enthrall the audience
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் தயாரிக்கப்பட்ட சில பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களைக் கவர இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: பெருமாள் சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A curated compilation of sacred hymns and religious songs in devotion and praise of the Lord Perumal is played back to back
programme.desc: பெருமாளின் பக்தி மற்றும் புகழுடன் கூடிய புனிதமான பாடல்கள் மற்றும் மத பாடல்களின் தொகுக்கப்பட்ட தொகுப்பு இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hymns and Hindu devotional songs praising Lord Muruga played back-to-back seeking his blessings
programme.desc: முருகப்பெருமானை போற்றும் இந்து பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு மற்றும் அவரது ஆசிகளை கோரி தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: கந்த குரு கவச்சம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader provides a detailed discourse on various spiritual teachings to devotees and encourages them to lead a faithful life
programme.desc: பக்தர்களுக்கு பல ஆன்மீக போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, விசுவாசமான வாழ்க்கையை வாழ அவர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.title: மனம் தேடும் ஆலயம்
programme.sub-title: Explore the history and cultural significance of various Hindu temples, the profound symbolism of revered deities and spiritual concepts
programme.desc: பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவம், போற்றப்படும் தெய்வங்களின் ஆழ்ந்த குறியீடுகள் மற்றும் ஆன்மீகக் கருத்துக்கள் குறித்து ஆராய்ந்து பாருங்கள்.

programme.title: பாலிமர் நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest updates and developments pertaining to various pressing issues and current affairs across Chennai
programme.desc: சென்னையின் முக்கிய பிரச்சினைகள் மற்றும் நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: டெலி ஷாப்பிங் / சினி மினி
programme.sub-title: The host presents a wide variety of television products that customers can purchase from their homes; a compilation of interesting sequences and melodious songs from popular Tamil movies is presented
programme.desc: பல்வேறு வகையான தொலைக்காட்சி தயாரிப்புகளை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்; பிரபலமான தமிழ் திரைப்பட பாடல்கள் வழங்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: டெலி ஷாப்பிங் / சினிமா சினிமா
programme.sub-title: The host talks about various products that can be bought from home. The host reviews the latest movie releases from the Kannada film industry and discusses topics that concern cinemagoers
programme.desc: வீட்டிலிருந்து வாங்கக்கூடிய தயாரிப்புகளை பற்றி பேசுகிறது; கன்னட திரையுலகின் திரைப்பட வெளியீடுகளை மதிப்பாய்வு செய்கிறது.

programme.title: டெலி ஷாப்பிங் / திரைக் கதம்பம்
programme.sub-title: Various products are showcased from multiple brands for customers to buy from the comfort of their homes; a curated collection of popular movie scenes
programme.desc: வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் வீடுகளில் இருந்தே வாங்கும் தயாரிப்புகள் காட்சிப்படுத்தப்படுகின்றன; திரைப்பட காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: சிங்காரவேலன்
programme.sub-title: Velan's mother tells him to find his cousin, Sumathi, who lives in the city and marry her. Velan sets out to find her with the help of a childhood photograph
programme.desc: வேலனின் தாயார், அவனது முறைப்பெண்ணைத் திருமணம் செய்துகொள்ளும்படி கூறியவுடன் அவரது விருப்பத்தை நிறைவேற்ற முடிவெடுக்கிறார்.

programme.title: குற்றம்

programme.title: கண் சிமிட்டும் நேரம்

programme.desc: கொலை நடந்த இடத்திலிருந்து தப்பிக்க முயலுகையில் விபத்தில் நினைவை இழக்கும் ராஜாவை பின்னர், லக்ஷ்மி பார்த்துக்கொள்கிறாள்.

programme.title: நூல் அரங்கம்

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்

programme.desc: கேரளாவின் பிரபல கோவிலில், பூசாரிகள்-பக்தர்கள் இணைந்து, சடங்குகளை செய்து, சிவனுக்கு இதயப்பூர்வ வழிபாடுகளை செய்கிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்
programme.sub-title: Devotees in large numbers visit a temple to perform a special ritual in order to synergise and unite the special powers of the deity
programme.desc: தெய்வத்தின் சிறப்பு சக்திகளை ஒருங்கிணைக்கவும் ஒன்றிணைக்கவும் ஒரு சிறப்பு சடங்கை செய்ய பக்தர்கள் கோயிலுக்கு வருகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஆர்ஜேஆர் - ஹெர்பல் ஸ்லாட்

programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்

programme.title: கும்பாபிஷேகம்

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: लूनी ट्यून्स कार्टून्स
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: बग्स बनी, डैफी डक, पोर्की पिग, सिल्वेस्टर, ट्वीटी, रोड रनर और कई मज़ेदार और अजीब-गरीब घटनाओं से गुज़रते हैं।.

programme.sub-title: Weasy, an opportunistic weasel with a penchant for burglary, finds himself incubating a large egg, which leads to significant changes in his life
programme.desc: चोरी के शौकीन, अवसरवादी नेवले वीज़ी को एक बड़ा अंडा सेने का काम सौंपा जाता है, जिससे उसके जीवन में महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव आते हैं।.

programme.title: बेन टेन
programme.sub-title: Ben Tennyson discovers a wristwatch which contains the Omnitrix. While he figures out its powers, he uses that to transform himself into various alien species
programme.desc: बेन टेनिसन को एक कलाई घड़ी मिलती है जिसमें ओमनीट्रिक्स है। जब वह उसकी शक्तियों का पता लगाता है, तब वह उसका इस्तेमाल खुद को कई एलियन प्रजातियों में बदलने के लिए करता है।.

credits.actor: Tara Strong (Ben Tennyson),Meagan Smith (Gwen Tennyson),Paul Eiding (Max Tennyson),Dee Bradley Baker (Wildmutt),Jim Ward (XLR8),Steve Blum (Heatblast),Richard McGonagle (Four Arms)

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.
