programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: हैरी एण्ड बन्नी
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.title: ओमी नंबर 1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: ओमी, नौ साल का एक अत्यधिक अमीर वारिस है, जिसका सामना ऐसी हास्यास्पद और आंखें खोल देने वाली स्थितियों से होता है जो उसे जीवन की वास्तविकताओं के बारे में सिखाती हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: बायोनिक मैक्स
programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: एक बायोनिक गिनी पिग, मैक्स और उसके सुनहरी मछली का सबसे अच्छा दोस्त, प्रयोगशाला से भागने और वन्य जीवन में फिट होने की कोशिश करने के बाद आकर्षक रोमांच पर निकलते हैं।.

programme.title: हन्टर एक्स हन्टर
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: गॉन फ्रीक्स अपने गायब पिता को खोजने की आशा एक शिकारी बनने का निश्चय करता है, जो एक विशिष्ट पेशेवर है तथा दुर्लभ राक्षसों और खजानों का शिकार करने के लिए जाना जाता है।.

programme.title: वन पीस
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: रबर से बना एक युवक मंकी डी लफी और उसके समुद्री डाकुओं की टीम एक काल्पनिक खजाने को खोजने के लिए एक रोमांचक एडवेंचर पर निकल पड़ते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: कितेरेत्सु
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: कितेरेत्सु, एक प्राथमिक विद्यालय का छात्र है जो लोगों की मदद करने के लिए अपने आविष्कारों का उपयोग करता है, और कोरोसुके, उसका रोबोट, अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों में भाग लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: वी बेर बीयर्स
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: तीन भालू भाई, ग्रिजली, पांडा और आइस, सैन फ्रांसिस्को खाड़ी क्षेत्र में जीवन को अजीब तरीके से जीते हैं, जब वे आधुनिक मानव समाज में घुलने की कोशिश करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: हैरी एण्ड बन्नी
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: हैरी एक महत्वाकांक्षी जादूगर है जो दूसरों को प्रभावित करने के लिए नए-नए जादू के खेल ईजाद करता है। हालाँकि, बन्नी, उसका नटखट खरगोश, हर बार उसे मात दे देता है और सारी वाहवाही लूट लेता है।.

programme.title: लार्वा
programme.sub-title: Two curious little worms explore the objects that they daily come across in their world which is located under the ground

programme.title: ஏழரை
programme.sub-title: The host presents a satirical commentary on some of the important political news and updates from the Indian state of Tamil Nadu
programme.desc: தமிழ்நாட்டிலிருந்து சில முக்கியமான அரசியல் செய்திகள் மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்புகள் குறித்த நையாண்டியாக வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: டாப் நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news and updates in areas like politics, crime, socio-economic issues and current affairs while highlighting the top stories of the day
programme.desc: அரசியல், குற்றம், சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள், நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் போன்ற துறைகளில் செய்திகள் மற்றும் புதுப்பிப்புகள்.

programme.title: ஆயுத எழுத்து
programme.sub-title: Kaliammal, a bold and manipulative woman, tries to keep the village under her fist. However, Indra, a young and ambitious sub-collector, vows to put an end to Kaliammal's evil regime
programme.desc: தனது கட்டுப்பாட்டில் கிராமத்தை கையாள நினைக்கும் தைரியமான காளியம்மாளின் ஆட்சிக்கு முடிவுக்கட்டும் துணை கலெக்டரான இந்திரா.

credits.actor: Mounika (Kaliammal),Sharanya Turadi (Indra),Anand Selvan (Sakthivel),Janani Ashok Kumar,Syamantha Kiran,Amzath Khan (Sakthivel),Sreethu Nair (Indra)

programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: திரை தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: The host engages in a meaningful conversation with the viewers and plays Tamil movie songs on their requests
programme.desc: பார்வையாளர்களுடன் உரையாடலில் ஈடுபட்டு, அவர்களுடைய வேண்டுகோளின் பேரில் தமிழ் திரைப்படப் பாடல்களை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: சுகமான ராகங்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular melodious songs composed and performed by various renowned artists played back to back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு நிகழ்த்தப்பட்ட பிரபலமான மெல்லிசைப் பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலய வழிபாடு
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar sheds light on the history behind various temples, as well as the significance and meaning of diverse rituals and customs
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கோயில்களுக்குப் பின்னால் உள்ள வரலாற்றையும், பல்வேறு சடங்குகள் மற்றும் பழக்கவழக்கங்களின் முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: ஆன்மீக கதைகள்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on various teachings and principles from the Hindu scriptures and encourages followers to reflect on the same
programme.desc: இந்து வேதங்களிலிருந்து பல போதனைகள் மற்றும் கொள்கைகளை விளக்கி பக்தர்களை அதைப் பற்றி சிந்திக்க ஊக்குவிக்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.title: நல்ல காலம் பிறக்குது
programme.sub-title: A renowned astrologer provides a comprehensive insight into the position of stars and makes astrological predictions for the 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: ஒரு பிரபல ஜோதிடர் நட்சத்திரங்களின் நிலையை பற்றிய விரிவான நுண்ணறிவை அளிப்பதோடு, 12 ராசிகளுக்கும் கணிப்புகளை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: வணக்கம் தமிழா
programme.sub-title: The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர்கள் பிரபல ஆளுமைகளுடன் தொடர்பு கொண்டு, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகளையும் வழங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: அனுமன்
programme.sub-title: When Hanuman, an ordinary boy, is blessed with extraordinary powers, he sets out on an adventurous journey and conquers various obstacles
programme.desc: ஒரு சாதாரண சிறுவனான அனுமன், அசாதாரண சக்திகளால் ஆசீர்வதிக்கப்பட்டபோது, ​​அவர் சாகசப் பயணத்தை மேற்கொண்டு தடைகளை வென்றார்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba

programme.title: శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: स्प्लिट्सविला
programme.sub-title: Young men and women go through various obstacles, challenges, and intense heartbreaks to find their perfect partner
programme.desc: युवा पुरुष और महिलाएं अपने आदर्श साथी को खोजने के लिए विभिन्न बाधाओं, चुनौतियों और दिल टूटने से गुजरते हैं।.

programme.title: रोडीस
programme.sub-title: Participants, selected from different parts of the country via auditions, compete against each other in various tasks to win the grand prize
programme.desc: देश के विभिन्न भागों से ऑडिशन के माध्यम से चुने गए प्रतिभागी भव्य पुरस्कार जीतने के लिए विभिन्न कार्यों में एक-दूसरे के साथ प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।.

credits.actor: Cyrus Sahukar,Rannvijay Singh,Bani J.,Gaelyn Mendonca,Sonu Sood

programme.desc: भक्तजन सर्वशक्तिमान ईश्वर से अपनी सच्ची प्रार्थना करने तथा दिव्य आशीर्वाद प्राप्त करने के लिए विभिन्न भक्ति गीत और भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक सर्वशक्तिमान की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings

programme.desc: ஊழலுக்கு எதிராகப் போராடும் ஒரு நபர், தன்னை போல தோற்றமுடைய நபரை சந்தித்த பிறகு, விஷயங்கள் குழப்பமடைகின்றன.

programme.title: பிக் பீஸ்ட்ஸ்: லாஸ்ட் ஆஃப் தி ஜெயண்ட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Beginning in the Americas, Patrick finds out more about the planet's largest predator, the sperm whale, comes face to face with grizzlies, and gets up close with the anaconda as he reveals how these giants shape their environments
programme.desc: பேட்ரிக் ஆரி, பூமியின் மிகப்பெரிய விலங்குகளின் வாழ்விடங்கள், பரிணாம வளர்ச்சி மற்றும் கண்டங்கள் முழுவதும் அவற்றை பாதுகாப்பதற்கான பாதுகாப்பு முயற்சிகளை ஆராய்ந்து, ஒரு பார்வையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கிங்டம்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: இயற்கையின் கடுமைகளைத் தாங்கி, பரந்த நிலப்பரப்புகளில் வாழும் வலிமையான விலங்குகளை ஆவணப்படுத்த உலகம் முழுவதும் பயணிக்கிறது.

programme.title: ஜப்பான்'ஸ் வைல்ட் சைட்
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: ஹொக்கைடோவின் காடுகள் முதல் ஒகினாவாவின் கடற்கரைகள் வரை, ஜப்பானின் விலங்குகளின் இரகசியங்களை வெளிக்கொணரும் ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: லா விடா என் எல் ஆஃப்ரிக்கா ஆர்டெண்ட்
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: பேட்டல் ஆஃப் த அல்ஃபாஸ்
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: விலங்கு இராச்சியத்தின் பல இனங்களுக்கு இடையிலான மோதலை ஆராய்ந்து, அதற்கு பின்னாலுள்ள நோக்கத்தை புரிந்துகொள்ளும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: பேட்டல் ஆஃப் த அல்ஃபாஸ்
programme.sub-title: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a duelling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind
programme.desc: விலங்கு இராச்சியத்தின் பல இனங்களுக்கு இடையிலான மோதலை ஆராய்ந்து, அதற்கு பின்னாலுள்ள நோக்கத்தை புரிந்துகொள்ளும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: ஹிப்போஸ் ஆஃப்டர் டார்க்
programme.sub-title: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark
programme.desc: அகச்சிவப்பு தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் மூலம், இரவின்போது காடுகளில் உள்ள நீர்யானைகள் தொடர்பான நிகழ்வுகளை வழங்கும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: டெக்சாஸ் கேட்டர் சேவர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The Texas team of gator savers take a paddle boat out for a rescue mission where the hunt for a sneaky gator ends in chest-deep water, and a gator with an eye problem gets a checkup
programme.desc: கேரி சௌரேஜ் குழுவினர், பல இடங்களிலிருந்து முதலைகளை மீட்டு, ஒரு புதிய சூழலில் அவை நலமாக வாழ்வதற்கு வழிவகை செய்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: ஜஸ்ட் அனிமல்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: பல்வேறு வகையான விலங்கு இனங்களின் சுவாரஸ்யமான உடல் அம்சங்கள், நடத்தைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்விடங்களை ஆராயும் திரைப்பட இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: க்ரிகீ! இட்'ஸ் த இர்வினிஸ்
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: விலங்குகளை கவனித்துக்கொள்ள ஆஸ்திரேலிய பூங்காவில் வேலை செய்யும் இர்வின் குடும்பத்தினர் பல போராட்டங்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: ஜுவல்ஸ் ஆஃப் த நேச்சுரல் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce
programme.desc: உலகின் பல்வேறு பகுதிகளிலிருந்து வனவிலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து அவற்றின் பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் கடுமையான தன்மையை விளக்கும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: இண்டு த வைல்ட்: இண்டியா
programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் கட்டுப்பாடற்ற நிலப்பரப்புகளில் வசிக்கும் பல்வேறு வனவிலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து விவரிக்கும் இயக்குனர் .

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: பல வாழ்விடங்கள் மற்றும் விலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றைப் பற்றிய சுவாரஸ்யமான உண்மைகளை பகிரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலரான ஆர்துரோ.

The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: நான்கு தனித்துவமான சுற்றுச்சூழல்களில் வாழ சிறிய எறும்புகள் முதல் பெரிய கரடிகள் வரை விலங்குகள் வாழ போராடுவது பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: வைல்ட் வைல்ட் பன்ச்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife

programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light on some of the deadliest predators in Australia, including reptiles and arachnids with unique biological weapons

programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs

programme.desc: இயற்கையின் மிகப் பெரிய கொடிய மிருகங்களை ஆவணப்படுத்தும் இயக்குனர், அவற்றின் இரையைத் தாக்கும் முறைகளை விளக்குகிறார்.

programme.title: தி வியூ ஃப்ரம் ஆன் ஹை
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: ரஷ்யாவின் இரண்டாவது பெரிய நகரமான செயின்ட் பீட்டர்ஸ்பர்க்கில் உள்ள நினைவுச் சின்னங்கள் மற்றும் கட்டிடங்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் கட்டிடக்கலையை பற்றி விளக்கும் ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீலங்கா - லெப்பர்ட்ஸ் ஆஃப் யாலா
programme.sub-title: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park
programme.desc: இலங்கையின் யாலா தேசிய பூங்காவில் வாழும் சிறுத்தைகளின் நடத்தை, உயிர்வாழும் உத்திகள் மற்றும் சவால்களை ஆராயும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: க்லேடியேட்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: நான்கு தனித்துவமான சுற்றுச்சூழல்களில் வாழ சிறிய எறும்புகள் முதல் பெரிய கரடிகள் வரை விலங்குகள் வாழ போராடுவது பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: வைல்ட் வைல்ட் பன்ச்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: பல வனவிலங்குகளின் நடத்தை மற்றும் உடல் அம்சங்கள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் இரையைத் தக்கவைக்க பயன்படுத்தும் உத்திகள் பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: அனிமல் அட்டாக் ரேட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light on some of the deadliest predators in Australia, including reptiles and arachnids with unique biological weapons
programme.desc: பல்வேறு விலங்குகளின் தாக்கும் உள்ளுணர்வும் அவற்றின் தனித்துவமான அம்சங்களைப் பற்றிய நுண்ணறிவையும் விளக்கும் ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் கேட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: மிகவும் சவாலான சில பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காகப் போராட தங்கள் திறன்களைப் பயன்படுத்தும் தீய காட்டு பூனைகளின் பல இனங்கள்.

programme.title: அ ரெஸ்ட்லெஸ் ப்ளானட்
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.title: டெசர்ட் டைனோசர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: பூமியின் மிகக் கடுமையான இடங்களில் ஒன்றான நமீப் பாலைவனத்தில், விலங்குகள் உயிர்வாழ உதவும் உயிரியல் திறன்களைப் பற்றிய ஒரு ஆவணப்படம்.

programme.title: பர்த் ஆஃப் ஸ்பீட்
programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs
programme.desc: இயக்குனர் சமவெளியில் ஒளிந்து,உணவு சேகரிக்க,குட்டியை காக்க வேகத்தை நம்பும் அச்சமற்ற இரு சிறுத்தைகளை காண்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: தி வியூ ஃப்ரம் ஆன் ஹை
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings

programme.title: வுல்வ்ஸ் \u0026 லயன்ஸ்: ஓல்ட் எனிமீஸ்
programme.sub-title: Canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines face endurance, while wolves rely on their privileged sense of smell in a constant fight for survival
programme.desc: நாயினங்களும் பூனையினங்களும் உலகளாவிய மேலாதிக்கத்திற்காக மோதுகின்றன, ஒவ்வொரு பிரதேசத்தையும் யார் ஆட்சி செய்கிறார்கள் என்பதை அவர்களின் வலிமையும் புத்தியும் தீர்மானிக்கின்றன.

programme.title: டாக்ஸ் இன் த லாண்ட் ஆஃப் லயன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion
programme.desc: ஜிம்பாப்வேயில் நெருக்கமாக பிணைக்கப்பட்ட காட்டு நாய்களின் அசாதாரண பயணத்தையும் அவற்றின் வேட்டையாடும் தருணங்களையும் அறிக.

programme.title: வைல்ட் வைல்ட் பன்ச்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: பல வனவிலங்குகளின் நடத்தை மற்றும் உடல் அம்சங்கள் மற்றும் அவற்றின் இரையைத் தக்கவைக்க பயன்படுத்தும் உத்திகள் பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: லெப்பர்ட் டைனாஸ்டி: தி ரைஸ் ஆஃப் ராணா
programme.sub-title: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a wild power struggle. Ageing leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance. As father and son clash, alliances form, and a new chapter begins
programme.desc: இந்தியாவின் ஜாலானா சரணாலயத்தில், ஆளும் வயதான சிறுத்தை பகதூரின் அதிகாரத்திற்கு அதன் மகன் ராணா சவால் விடுகிறான். தந்தை மகனுக்கு இடையிலான இந்த அதிகார மோதலில் வலிமை, வியூகம் மற்றும் உயிர்வாழும் உள்ளுணர்வுகள் தீவிரமடைகின்றன.

programme.title: வைல்ட் அண்ட் வண்டர்ஃபூல் டென்மார்க்
programme.sub-title: Getting up close and personal with Danish wildlife that live in the country's forests. The cameras film inside a fox den with a mother fox and her newborn cubs, and follow a majestic golden eagle whilst it is out hunting
programme.desc: விலங்கு இராச்சியத்தில் வெளிப்படும் நிகழ்வுகளால் டென்மார்க் விலங்குகளை கண்டறிதல்.பிறப்பு-இறப்பு, இனச்சேர்க்கையின் கதைகள்.

programme.title: மைண்ட் வைல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Has a look at how animals build shelters that are more complicated than simple nests
programme.desc: இயற்கையான வாழ்விடங்களில் வனவிலங்குகளின் உயிர்வாழும் நடத்தைகள் மூலம் அவற்றின் அறிவின் தன்மையை ஆராயும் நிபுணர்கள்.

programme.title: ஆன் த ட்ரெய்ல் ஆஃப் ஸ்னோ லெப்பர்ட்
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: பனி சிறுத்தைகளை தேடி, பாறை நிலப்பரப்புகளில் அவை நடமாடும் அரிய காட்சியை காணும் நிபுணர்களின் அனுபவங்களை அறியும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: பாஸ்டியன் ஆஃப் த ஜெயண்ட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra
programme.desc: வடகிழக்கு இந்திய காடுகளில் ஆசிய யானைகளையும், மனிதருக்கும் விலங்குகளுக்கும் இணக்கமான எதிர்காலத்திற்கான முயற்சிகளும்.

programme.title: நேச்சுரல் பார்ன் மான்ஸ்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Sean travels to Costa Rica and comes face-to-face with a monster born from the jungle, the Brazilian Wandering Spider
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: சிபெல்லா - த மிராக்கிள் சீட்டா
programme.sub-title: Sibella, a wild cheetah in South Africa, has a near-death experience. Later, after being rescued and brought to Samara, she rises to become one of the most skilled hunters
programme.desc: ஆபத்திலிருந்து சமாராவுக்கு மீட்டு செல்லப்படும் தென்னாப்பிரிக்க சிறுத்தை சிபெல்லா, சிறந்த வேட்டையாடும் மிருகமாகிறது.

programme.sub-title: Covers the formation of the isthmus of Panama between South America and North America, a geological event which changed the course of evolution and world climate
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.sub-title: Animals face challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration

programme.title: द फ़ैमिली स्टार
programme.sub-title: Govardhan, a diligent architect, longs for a partner who understands his commitment to his large family. When Indu, a new tenant, moves in, his life starts to unfold in a new direction
programme.desc: मेहनती वास्तुकार गोवर्धन, अपने बड़े परिवार में रह सकने वाले, साथी की चाहत रखता है। जब इंदु, एक नई किरायेदार, उसके घर आती है, तो उसका जीवन एक नई दिशा में चला जाता है।.

credits.actor: Vijay Deverakonda,Mrunal Thakur,Jagapathi Babu,Divyansha Kaushik,Vennela Kishore,Ravi Prakash,Raja Chembolu,Rohini Hattangadi,Vasuki Anand,Abhinaya,Ravi Babu

programme.title: रेंडागाम
programme.sub-title: Attracted by the prospect of making easy money, an unemployed young man agrees to befriend David, a man with memory loss
programme.desc: आसानी से पैसा कमाने की संभावना से आकर्षित होकर, एक बेरोजगार युवक, डेविड नामक एक स्मृति-विहीन व्यक्ति से दोस्ती करने के लिए तैयार हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Aravind Swamy (David/Assaianar),Kunchacko Boban (Kichu/David),Eesha Rebba (Kalyani),Jackie Shroff (Adiga),Aadukalam Naren (Sreedharan (Chachan)),Amalda Liz (Kichu's informer),Jins Baskar (Randaman),Laban Ranae (Photographer)

programme.title: कलम
programme.sub-title: Gautham and Deeksha, along with their daughter, move into an isolated bungalow gifted to them by Gautham's father. Soon, they start experiencing paranormal activities around the house
programme.desc: गौतम और दीक्षा अपनी बेटी के साथ एक सुन सान बंगले में रहने चले जाते हैं, जो गौतम के पिता ने उन्हें उपहार में दिया था। जल्द ही, वे घर के आसपास भयानक गतिविधियों का अनुभव करने लगते हैं।.

credits.actor: Amzath Khan,Pooja Ramachandran,Lakshmi Priyaa Chandramouli,Madhusudhanan,Nassar,Kani Kusruti,Rekha Suresh,N. L. Srinivasan

programme.title: चित्ता
programme.sub-title: Living a quiet life with his niece, Eeswaran manages to provide for her and nurtures her like a parent. However, his journey takes an insidious turn when she goes missing
programme.desc: पोन्नी और सुंदरी जंगल का दौरा करते हैं और पोन्नी लापता हो जाती है, जिसमें सुंदरी के चाचा ईश्वरन को दोषी ठहराया जाता है। समस्याएँ तब बढ़ती हैं जब सुंदरी गायब हो जाती है और ईश्वरन उसे खोजने निकलता है।.

credits.actor: Nimisha Sajayan,Siddharth,Sahasra Shree,S. Aafiyah Tasneem,Anjali Nair,Baalaji S U

programme.title: पेट्टा
programme.sub-title: In a bid to save his best friend's son Anwar, hostel warden Kaali goes against local goons. However, everything goes haywire when he is forced to face his past
programme.desc: अपने सबसे अच्छे दोस्त के बेटे अनवर को बचाने के लिए हॉस्टल वार्डन काली स्थानीय गुंडों के खिलाफ जाता है। हालाँकि, जब उसे अपने अतीत का सामना करना पड़ता है तब सब कुछ गड़बड़ हो जाता है।.

credits.actor: Rajnikanth (Kaali),Vijay Sethupathi (Jithu),Trisha Krishnan (Saro),M. Sasikumar (Malik),Nawazuddin Siddiqui (Singaar Singh),Bobby Simha (Michael),Megha Akash (Anu),J. Mahendran (Rajapandi)

programme.title: लिगर
programme.sub-title: A talented young MMA fighter trains hard to rise up the ranks. However, his goals are hindered when his lover is kidnapped
programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली युवा एमएमए फाइटर रैंक बढ़ाने के लिए कड़ी मेहनत करता है। हालाँकि, उसके लक्ष्य तब बाधित होते हैं जब उसके प्रेमी का अपहरण कर लिया जाता है।.

credits.actor: Vijay Deverakonda,Mike Tyson,Ananya Panday,Ramya Krishnan,Ronit Roy,Vinni Mobstaz,Abhinay Raj Singh,Shovon Jaman,Makrand Deshpande

programme.title: थीरन
programme.sub-title: Theeran, a dedicated police officer, pays the price for his honesty and faces hardships when he tries to investigate the illegal activities conducted by a powerful gangster
programme.desc: एक समर्पित पुलिस अधिकारी, थेरन को अपनी ईमानदारी की कीमत चुकानी पड़ती है और जब वह शक्तिशाली गैंगस्टर द्वारा की गई अवैध गतिविधियों की जांच करने की कोशिश करता है तब उसे कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ता है।.

credits.actor: Karthi,Rakul Preet Singh,Abhimanyu Singh,Bose Venkat,Praveena,Manobala,Sathyan,R.N.R. Manohar

programme.title: पोगारु
programme.sub-title: A local thug stands up against the atrocities committed on common people and fights to secure justice for them, thus earning the public's respect and affection
programme.desc: एक स्थानीय गुंडा आम लोगों पर होने वाले अत्याचारों के खिलाफ लड़ता है और उन्हें न्याय दिलाने के लिए लड़ता है जिसके कारण लोग उसे चाहने और सम्मान करने लगते हैं।.

credits.actor: Dhruva Sarja,Rashmika Mandanna,Sampath Raj,Dhananjay,Chikkanna,Raghavendra Rajkumar,Pavitra Lokesh,P. Ravi Shankar,Raj Deepak Shetty,Kai Greene,'Kuri' Prathap,Tara Anuradha

programme.title: ना सामी रंगा
programme.sub-title: A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda
programme.desc: एक व्यक्ति अपनी अद्वितीय शक्ति और क्रूर स्वभाव के कारण अपने गांव में बहुत कुख्यात हो जाता है, जिसके कारण वह क्रूर इरादे वाले असामाजिक तत्वों का निशाना बन जाता है।.

credits.actor: Nagarjuna Akkineni,Allari Naresh,Raj Tarun,Ashika Ranganath,Mirnaa,Rukshar Dhillon,Ravi Varma

programme.desc: ஸ்ரீகாளஹஸ்தி கோயிலில் மகா சிவராத்திரி விழாவைக் கொண்டாடும் வகையில் பல்வேறு சடங்குகளை செய்யும் சீடர்கள் மற்றும் பூசாரிகள்.

programme.title: அனுமத் வைபவம் ஸ்ரீ வட்டிபர்த்தி பத்மாகர் காரு
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர் சர்வவல்லவரின் போதனைகளை பற்றி விளக்கமளித்து, ஆன்மீக பாதையில் செல்ல பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் ராமாயணம் கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டா
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar delivers a discourse on the fourth book of the Valmiki Ramayana, 'Kishkindha Kanda'. The chapters focus on Lord Rama and Lakshmana searching for Sita
programme.desc: வால்மீகி ராமாயணத்தின் நான்காவது புத்தகமான 'கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டம்' குறித்து ஒரு சமய அறிஞர் சொற்பொழிவாற்றுகிறார், அதன் அத்தியாயங்கள் ராமர் மற்றும் லட்சுமணன் சீதையைத் தேடுவதை மையமாகக் கொண்டது.

programme.title: மகா பாரதம் - உத்யோக பர்வம்
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader reads excerpts from religious literature to guide devotees with divine teachings to help them find fulfilment in their lives
programme.desc: ஒரு மத தலைவர், பக்தர்கள் தங்கள் வாழ்வில் முழுமை பெற உதவும் தெய்வீகப் போதனைகளைக் கொண்டு வழிகாட்டுவதற்காக, சமய இலக்கியங்களிலிருந்து சில பகுதிகளை வாசித்துக் காட்டுகிறார்.

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.sub-title: Little Singham sets out on a challenging mission to save Mirchinagar from an impending snowfall that threatens to freeze the entire city

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, an honest but ferocious police officer, fights against injustice and defends his town from formidable enemies
programme.desc: నిజాయితీపరుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం అన్యాయానికి వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడుతూ, శత్రువుల నుండి తన పట్టణాన్ని కాపాడతాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: జై జగన్నాథ్
programme.sub-title: The host shines light on the annual chariot procession held in the honour of Lord Jagannath in Puri, Odisha, which is attended by numerous devotees from all over the country
programme.desc: ఒడిశాలోని పూరీలో జగన్నాథ స్వామి గౌరవార్థం జరిగే వార్షిక రథోత్సవంపై వివరిస్తారు, దేశం నలుమూలల నుండి భక్తులు హాజరవుతారు.

programme.title: మహాశైతాన్ ప్రేత్ పురాణ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem and his friends have the same terrifying dream as everyone else in the entire village. Bhoomi tells them that Mahashaitaan is manipulating their dreams
programme.desc: భీమ్,అతని మిత్రులు గరల్గుఫా అనే ప్రేతనగర మహాషైతాన్‌ను ఓడించి, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌కు మాత్రమే కాక, ప్రపంచానికి శాంతి చేకూరుస్తారు.

programme.title: మహాశైతాన్ ప్రేత్ పురాణ్
programme.sub-title: As Shaitaan takes Sapanpret's powers and kidnaps Jaggu, Bheem and his friends hurry to reach the second pret nagri before him. Eventually, Bheem battles Shaitaan, but he departs for the third Pretnagri

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం ఔర్ కృష్ణ: కన్స్ కా ఆతంక్- 1 - దోస్తీ కి దోర్ అండ్ కర్మ కలష్ కి ఖోజ్
programme.sub-title: Kans teams up with Shambhala Jambala to resurrect himself by using a life-giving tree. Soon, Little Singham and Krishna set out to stop them before their evil plan destroys Earth
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, కృష్ణ శంభాల జంబలాతో కలిసిన కన్స్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళిక భూమిని నాశనం చేసే ముందు వారిని ఆపడానికి బయలుదేరతారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం ఔర్ కృష్ణ: కన్స్ కా ఆతంక్ పార్ట్ - 2 - రీతు పత్తర్ అండ్ సంతులన్ కి నావ్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham and Krishna go to Prakatalay in a bid to find the 'Ritu Pathar'. But Kans and his demons are hell-bent on stopping them from completing their mission
programme.desc: రీతు పత్తర్'ని వెతుకుతూ ప్రకటాలయ్‌కి వెళ్లిన లిటిల్ సింగం, కృష్ణను అడ్డుకోవడానికి కన్స్, అతడి రాక్షసులు ప్రయత్నిస్తారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం ఔర్ కృష్ణ: కన్స్ కా ఆతంక్ పార్ట్ - 3 - సూర్య నగరి అండ్ లౌట్ ఆయా కన్స్
programme.sub-title: Amidst their battle against Kans, Little Singham and Krishna travel to Surya Nagri. There, they are attacked by the evil Shambhala Jambala who is close to resurrecting Kans
programme.desc: కాన్స్‌పై వారి యుద్ధం మధ్య లిటిల్ సింగం, కృష్ణ సూర్య నగరికి వెళతారు. అక్కడ, దుష్ట శంభాల జంబాల వారిపై దాడి చేస్తారు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: సంపత్ చంపత్
programme.sub-title: Follow the hilarious misadventures of Sampat and Champat, two bumbling thieves who constantly hatch chaotic plans that backfire, landing them in endless trouble with the local police
programme.desc: సంపత్, చంపత్ అనే ఇద్దరు చేతకాని దొంగలు నిరంతరం స్థానిక పోలీసుల చిక్కుల్లో పడే హాస్యభరితమైన సాహసాలను అనుసరించండి.

programme.title: ఎల్ఎస్ 3డి టిఎఫ్ బాహుబలి ఫ్రెండ్స్-రోర్ ఆఫ్ అపర్శత్రు
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: టెలివిజన్ రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన కార్యక్రమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింహం: ది లెజెండ్ ఆఫ్ హీమ్ కేసరి
programme.sub-title: Little Singham sets out on a challenging mission to save Mirchinagar from an impending snowfall that threatens to freeze the entire city
programme.desc: రాబోయే మంచు కురిసే విపత్తు నుండి మిర్చినగర్‌ను రక్షించడానికి, లిటిల్ సింగం ఒక సవాలుతో కూడిన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభించాడు.

programme.title: సిబి అండ్ ఎల్ఎస్ రైజ్ ఆఫ్ అంషక్స్: రిటర్న్ ఆఫ్ అగ్నివీర్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: టెలివిజన్ రంగంలోని అత్యుత్తమమైన కార్యక్రమాలను కొన్నింటిని అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం అంతరిక్ష్ కా రఖ్వాల
programme.sub-title: Little Singham takes part in a fighting match with the mighty aliens in a bid to defeat the evil forces and save the Earth
programme.desc: దుష్ట శక్తులను ఓడించి, భూమిని రక్షించే ప్రయత్నంలో లిటిల్ సింగం శక్తివంతమైన గ్రహాంతరవాసులతో పోటీపడతాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: The marriage vow \"till death do us part\" lives up to its promise for the couples featured in \"Happily Never After.\" It's a wedding show and police drama rolled into one, as the best days in the lives of brides and grooms tragically turn when homicides crash the honeymoons. Each episode tells the true story -- narrated by actress Marlo Thomas -- of a newlywed's murder, interspersed with flashbacks to happier days for the couple. Dr. Wendy Walsh, who holds a Ph.D. in clinical psychology and is a co-host on the syndicated program \"The Doctors,\" offers commentary on the behavioral twists and turns in each story.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan Short fell in love with cars when he first laid eyes on a 1967 Camaro. He bought a used model as a teenager, but because he couldn't pay someone else to restore it, he learned how to do the work himself. After a stint in the Army, Short decided to make his passion for classic cars his life's work, and FantomWorks was born. Today the Norfolk, Va., company is the largest auto restoration shop in the U.S., and this reality series shows how Short and his team meticulously refurbish some of America's favorite rides. Drama ensues in the form of personality clashes, cost overruns, irate customers and other issues, which are compounded by Short's reputation as a straight shooter who won't accept substandard results.

programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्येक्रम।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: यस बॉस
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्येक्रम।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

credits.actor: Hiba Nawab,Nikhil Khurana,Anup Upadhyay,Soma Rathod,Harveer Singh,Raashi Bawa,Firoz Khan,Naveen Bawa,Saheb Das Manikpuri

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: காயத்திரி
programme.sub-title: Gayathri, a young girl, works as a postwoman to support her family. However, she struggles to overcome various tribulations
programme.desc: இளம்பெண் காயத்திரி, தனது குடும்பத்தை ஆதரிப்பதற்காக தபால்காரராக பணிபுரிகிறார். இருப்பினும், அவள் பல்வேறு இன்னல்களை கடக்க போராடுகிறாள்.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.title: బిగ్ బీస్ట్స్: లాస్ట్ ఆఫ్ ది జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: Beginning in the Americas, Patrick finds out more about the planet's largest predator, the sperm whale, comes face to face with grizzlies, and gets up close with the anaconda as he reveals how these giants shape their environments
programme.desc: పాట్రిక్ ఆరీ భూమిపై ఉన్న అతిపెద్ద జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, పరిణామం, వాటిని రక్షించడానికి చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ కింగ్డమ్స్
programme.sub-title: Rivers are the lifeblood Africa's arid landscapes. But while they offer sustenance, the kings of the water take no prisoners here
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రకృతి కాఠిన్యాన్ని భరించిన, విశాలమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే కొన్ని బలమైన జంతువులను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: జపాన్స్ వైల్డ్ సైడ్
programme.sub-title: As winter's harshest period passes, the changing season ushers in new life and fresh challenges for Japan's wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జపాన్‌లోని ప్రసిద్ధ జంతువుల రహస్యాలను కనుగొనడానికి హోక్కైడో అడవుల నుండి ఒకినావా తీరప్రాంతాల వరకు ప్రయాణిస్తారు.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: Madagascar is home to strange animals not found anywhere else on Earth. When these animals fight for supremacy, their battles are just as strange -- from weird neck-wrestling weevils to ring-tailed lemur mums that go into battle with baby on board
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: Australia is home to an eclectic array of creatures, and the ways to succeed as an alpha are just as diverse. The beach turns into a duelling ground, and the outback becomes a boxing ring, as animals face off with their own kind
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: హిప్పోస్ ఆఫ్టర్ డార్క్
programme.sub-title: Some of the most amazing hippo behaviour happens after dark
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సింహాల అహంకారం, హిప్పోల మంద మధ్య రాత్రి పడుతుండగా భయంకరమైన ఎద్దు రక్షణలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాటాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: టెక్సాస్ గేటర్ సేవర్స్
programme.sub-title: The Texas team of gator savers take a paddle boat out for a rescue mission where the hunt for a sneaky gator ends in chest-deep water, and a gator with an eye problem gets a checkup
programme.desc: గ్యారీ సౌరేజ్, అతని బృందం వివిధ అసాధారణ ప్రదేశాలలోని మొసళ్ళను రక్షించి, కొత్త వాతావరణంలో వాటి సంక్షేమానికి తోడ్పడతారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: జ్యూయెల్స్ ఆఫ్ ద న్యాచురల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత జంతువుల భీకర స్వభావం, సంరక్షణ గురించి వివరిస్తూ, ప్రపంచంలోని పలు ప్రాంతాల వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఇంటు ది వైల్డ్: ఇండియా
programme.sub-title: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు భారతదేశ అపరిమితమైన ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలలో నివసించే విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల గురించి అంతర్దృష్టిని అందించారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్

programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. programme.title: వైపర్ క్వీన్స్
programme.sub-title: Velvet the Gaboon viper and Therma the rattlesnake are two mothers facing different challenges in extreme, contrasting landscapes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రెండు పాములు వేర్వేరు ప్రకృతిదృశ్యాలలో ఎదుర్కొనే సవాళ్లను వివరిస్తారు,వారికుటుంబాలను పెంచడానికి అవి పోరాడతాయి.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: Canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines face endurance, while wolves rely on their privileged sense of smell in a constant fight for survival
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: ది సావన్నా: వైల్డ్ హ్యాపీనెస్
programme.desc: The Savannah: Wild Happiness.

programme.title: గ్లాడియేటర్స్
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత నాలుగు పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలలో జీవితాన్ని నిర్వచించే యుద్ధాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, జంతురాజ్యంలో తీవ్రమైన పోటీలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఆర్మరీ
programme.sub-title: Bears, owls, and tigers use their sharp claws to fight and catch prey, while baboons, wolves and woodchucks use their teeth as weapons
programme.desc: Only the strongest survive in the animal kingdom, where the competition for food, territory or mates means employing skilfully crafted tricks of the trade. `Animal Armory' incorporates high-end imagery and computer graphics to reveal how wildlife use their teeth, claws, antlers, camouflage, venom and even spit to threaten and intimidate rivals and predators alike. With weapons of deception, animals disarm and entice prey to their death. Meanwhile, perhaps the oldest weapons employed by animals are projectiles, which have evolved into their own versions of poison-tipped harpoons, chemical missiles and high-powered bullets.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: In Africa, lions and wolves lead their ecosystems. Discover the strength, social strategies and hierarchies behind how they raise and protect their young
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఆన్ ది రన్
programme.sub-title: Follow a young tiger in India that has been forced out of its home territory by another male and has to struggle for survival
programme.desc: తన భూభాగం నుండి బయటికి వెళ్ళిపోయినా చిన్న మగ పులి కుమాల్, అడవిలో జీవిస్తూ, ఎలా పెరిగి, పెద్దదయ్యిందో చూడండి.

programme.title: మెడిటరేనియన్ హంటర్స్
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: లెపర్డ్ డైనాస్టీ: ది రైజ్ ఆఫ్ రాణా
programme.desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a wild power struggle. Ageing leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance. As father and son clash, alliances form, and a new chapter begins.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్
programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light on some of the deadliest predators in Australia, including reptiles and arachnids with unique biological weapons
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వివిధ క్రూర జంతువుల దాడి విధానాలు, ప్రవృత్తిని వివరిస్తూ, వాటి విచిత్ర లక్షణాలపై అంతర్దృష్టులను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: రేస్ అఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Desert animals have evolved to handle heat and lack of water. This includes scorpions, which have existed since life first crawled from the sea
programme.desc: స్వీయ ర‌క్ష‌ణ‌లో భాగంగా పరిసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన జంతువుల గురించి వ్యాఖ్యాత వివ‌రిస్తారు.

programme.title: రేస్ అఫ్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: The African Savannah sees thousands of battles each day. Learn how elephants survive on a diet that even the strictest vegetarian would avoid
programme.desc: స్వీయ ర‌క్ష‌ణ‌లో భాగంగా పరిసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా అభివృద్ధి చెందిన జంతువుల గురించి వ్యాఖ్యాత వివ‌రిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది క్విక్ అండ్ ది స్లో
programme.sub-title: Hitting the gas with hawks, cheetahs, and other speed demons to learn why first-in-class acceleration can be an evolutionary advantage, then pumping the brakes with Earth's biggest slowpokes to see why, sometimes, slow and steady wins the race
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతువుల వేగాల వర్ణపటాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తూ, ఈ విరుద్ధమైన ప్రవర్తనలను రూపొందించే పర్యావరణ కారకాలను పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: నేచర్స్ ఫాస్ట్ ఎటాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In the battle between predator and prey, camouflage and speed often make the difference between life and death, as some of the fastest animals can strike and kill in the blink of an eye
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: శ్రీలంక - లెపర్డ్స్ ఆఫ్ యాలా
programme.sub-title: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు యాలాలోని చిరుతపులుల సన్నిహిత రూపాన్ని అనిందించి, వాటి ప్రవర్తనలు, మనుగడ ప్రవృత్తిని ప్రదర్శిస్తాడు.

programme.sub-title: For millions of years, Africa has been tearing apart in a geological hot zone called the Great Rift Valley, a magnet for the continent's animals
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.
